title: DLinear block: moving-average split
summary: The implemented operator replaces each sample with a centered local mean and assigns the input minus that mean to a second stream. Edge replication maintains the original length. AUTOFORMER_BLOCK, DLINEAR_BLOCK and MOVING_AVERAGE_DECOMPOSITION_BLOCK call the same numeric implementation at equal settings; their method identifiers record provenance. The animation therefore shows the same numerical mechanism for all three, with a separate named asset for each entry.

steps.title: Specify the filter
steps.text: Inspect the normalized filter weights and the replicated-edge input window used for a local mean.

steps.title: Move along the series
steps.text: At each sample, multiply the local values by the same fixed kernel and sum them to form the trend.

steps.title: Subtract the trend
steps.text: Compute the nontrend stream as the input minus the smoothed trend, sample by sample.

steps.title: Inspect the output contract
steps.text: The two streams already reconstruct the input, leaving a derived residual of zero up to arithmetic precision.

parameters.name: moving_avg
parameters.effect: Sets the smoothing window. Larger windows average more samples; even requests become odd windows.

parameters.name: window
parameters.effect: Acts as an alias after moving_avg. If neither is supplied, period hints are checked before the default window of 25.

parameters.name: primary_period
parameters.effect: Can supply a window hint; this operator does not fit a periodic template.

cautions: The three registered moving-average block names are numerical aliases at equal configuration.
This is the decomposition head. It does not execute Autoformer attention or DLinear's fitted forecasting projections.
The nontrend stream can contain noise and transients. Here season = input - trend, so the derived residual is zero by construction.
The centered filter uses future neighbours relative to an interior sample in a full-record analysis.

references.title: Zeng et al. (2023), Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?

trace_note: Intermediate arrays are computed with the implemented operator helpers. The final trend, season and residual are checked against public decompose(). The animation explains this standalone experimental block; its source architecture is cited for provenance.
input_note: Deterministic synthetic teaching signal; not a benchmark.

checks.validation_scope: One deterministic teaching input; no benchmark claim.
